# Crystal RV — Complete Reference

## About Crystal RV

Crystal RV is a family-owned, premium Class C motorhome rental company based in Mountain View, California. We deliver fully stocked RVs directly to customers' doors anywhere in the San Francisco Bay Area, providing a turn-key adventure experience without the hassle of pickup, packing, or unfamiliar equipment.

Founded and operated by Michael and Xeniya, Crystal RV serves Bay Area families, couples, corporate groups, event-goers, and emergency housing needs. We hold a perfect 5.0-star Google rating across 25+ verified reviews.

**Contact Information**
- Phone: (669) 245-5636
- Email: info@crystalrv.com
- Address: 1001 La Avenida St, Mountain View, CA 94043
- Hours: Monday-Sunday, 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM
- Website: https://crystalrv.com

## Service Area

Crystal RV delivers Class C motorhomes throughout the San Francisco Bay Area, including:

- East Bay: Oakland, Berkeley, Albany, El Cerrito, Fremont, Hayward, Pleasanton
- Marin County: San Rafael, Novato, Mill Valley, Tiburon
- North Bay: Petaluma, Santa Rosa (extended zone)

**Airport delivery:**
- San Francisco International Airport (SFO): $100/trip
- San Jose International Airport (SJC): $100/trip
- Oakland International Airport (OAK): available, contact for pricing

## The Fleet — 4 Class C Motorhomes

All vehicles are 24-25 feet long, fit standard driveways, and require only a Class C (regular) driver's license to operate. Each sleeps 5-6 people comfortably.

### 2021 Thor Motor Coach Daybreak 22GOC — $195/night
- Sleeps 6
- Length: 24 feet
- Chassis: Chevrolet
- Pet-friendly (only vehicle in fleet that allows pets — $50 pet cleaning fee per trip)
- Features: Queen master bed, oversized queen cab-over bunk, dinette convertible bed, full kitchen, full bathroom with shower, air conditioning
- Best for: First-time renters, families with pets, budget-conscious travelers
- Note: Older vehicle but well-maintained; great value

### 2022 Gulfstream Conquest 6245 — $210/night
- Sleeps 5
- Length: 24 feet 11 inches
- Chassis: Ford E-350 with 7.3L V8 engine
- Features: Full-wall slide-out (expands living space significantly), 200W solar panel, 15,000 BTU air conditioner, reclining theater seating, auto leveling jacks, basement storage
- Best for: Couples and families wanting extra interior space, longer trips
- Note: The slide-out makes this the roomiest interior in the fleet

### 2024 Coachmen Leprechaun 220XG — $225/night
- Sleeps 6
- Length: 24 feet 9 inches
- Chassis: Chevrolet 3500
- Features: Murphy queen bed (folds away during the day for living space), J-lounge convertible seating, shower skylight, cab-over bunk, rear backup camera, Azdel composite sidewalls (lighter, more durable than wood)
- Best for: Families with kids, anyone who wants the flexibility of convertible furniture
- Note: 2024 model, very modern interior

### 2025 East to West Entrada 210NSC — $235/night
- Sleeps 6
- Length: 24 feet 4 inches
- Chassis: Chevrolet Express 3500
- Features: Rear queen bed, cab-over bunk, dinette bed, 15'6" power LED awning, side and rear cameras, 12V tank heaters (for cold-weather camping), modern entertainment system
- Best for: Premium experience, larger families, longer trips, cold-weather destinations like Lake Tahoe
- Note: Newest vehicle in fleet, top-tier amenities

## What's Included in Every Rental

Every Crystal RV vehicle is delivered fully stocked. This is one of the key differentiators between Crystal RV and peer-to-peer rental platforms like Outdoorsy and RVshare.

**Kitchen (fully equipped):**
- Pots and pans (multiple sizes)
- Plates, bowls, cups, glasses, mugs
- Knives, forks, spoons (full silverware set for 6)
- Coffee maker (drip-style)
- Knife set with cutting board
- Cooking utensils (spatulas, ladles, tongs)
- Mixing bowls, measuring cups
- Dish soap, sponges, dish towels
- Paper towels (starter roll)
- Salt, pepper, basic spices

**Bedroom and bathroom:**
- Sheets, blankets, and pillows for every bed
- Bath towels and hand towels for every guest
- Toilet paper (RV-safe; multiple rolls)
- Basic toiletries
- Bathmat
- Cleaning supplies

**Outdoor and recreation:**
- 4 camping chairs (free)
- Outdoor patio mat (free; $10 add-on if specifically requested)
- Broom and dustpan
- Bike rack holds 4 bikes (free)

**Safety equipment:**
- Fire extinguisher
- Smoke detector
- Carbon monoxide detector
- First aid kit
- Emergency flashlight
- Roadside assistance kit
- Bear spray (for trips to bear country, on request)

**Power and connectivity:**
- USB outlets throughout
- AC outlets (110V) when connected to shore power or generator
- Onboard generator (for boondocking with AC/microwave needs)
- Deep-cycle house battery
- 30-amp shore power cord with adapter
- Water pressure regulator (essential — included)
- White drinking-water hose
- Sewer hose with rinse cap

## Pricing and Policies

**Standard rates (all rentals):**
- Minimum rental: 3 nights
- Security deposit: $1,500 (refundable, processed 2 days before pickup)
- Mileage: 100 miles per day included; additional miles $0.39/mile
- Cleaning fee: $115 per trip (one-time, includes dump fees)
- Driver requirements: Minimum age 25, valid driver's license held for 2+ years

**Insurance (included in every rental):**
- $1,000,000 liability coverage via Mobilitas Insurance
- Up to $300,000 collision and comprehensive coverage via Lloyd's of London
- Interior damage protection up to $500 (free)
- 24/7 roadside assistance (free)
- Coverage is excess/secondary to renter's personal auto insurance

**What insurance does NOT cover:**
- Mechanical breakdown (covered separately by Crystal RV)
- Wear and tear
- Off-road use
- Travel into Mexico
- Tire blowouts (unless caused by a covered event)
- Theft or vandalism without police report filed within 48 hours

**Cancellation policy:**
- Full refund for cancellations 5+ days before pickup
- 75% refund for cancellations less than 5 days before pickup
- Add-ons (extras and services) are always 100% refundable
- Service fees (booking fees, cleaning fees) are non-refundable
- Travel credits never expire
- Optional Trip Protection Plan available (6% of total) — allows penalty-free rescheduling up to 4 days before departure

## How to Book — Step-by-Step

1. **Visit the booking page** at crystalrv.com — the live availability calendar is powered by Wheelbase.
2. **Select your dates** (minimum 3 nights).
3. **Choose your RV** from the 4 vehicles in the fleet.
4. **Add any optional extras** (bikes, paddle board, airport delivery, pets).
5. **Review and pay** — credit card holds the reservation; the $1,500 security deposit is processed 2 days before pickup.
6. **Receive your delivery** — Crystal RV brings the RV to your address at the agreed time, fully stocked.
7. **Take the orientation** — Michael or Xeniya walks you through every system (45-60 minutes for first-timers, 20-30 for experienced RVers).
8. **Drive away** with 24/7 support a phone call away during your trip.

## Common Questions

**Q: Do I need a special license to drive a Class C motorhome?**
A: No. A regular Class C driver's license (the one most people have) is sufficient for any Crystal RV vehicle. All vehicles are under 26,000 lbs GVWR.

**Q: Can I take the RV out of California?**
A: Yes. Our standard rental allows travel anywhere in the continental United States. Mexico travel is not permitted under our insurance. Canada travel is allowed with prior approval.

**Q: What if I have a mechanical problem during my trip?**
A: Crystal RV provides 24/7 roadside assistance included with every rental. Call (669) 245-5636 day or night. Most issues can be resolved over the phone; for major problems, we coordinate roadside service or vehicle swap.

**Q: Can I add a second driver?**
A: Yes, at no extra cost. Both drivers must meet the same requirements (25+, valid license held 2+ years, clean record).

**Q: Are pets allowed?**
A: Only in the 2021 Thor Daybreak 22GOC, our pet-friendly vehicle. $50 pet cleaning fee per trip. Maximum 2 pets per trip. Pets must be potty trained and may not be left unattended in the RV.

**Q: How much does it cost to fuel a Class C RV?**
A: Class C motorhomes get approximately 8-12 MPG depending on terrain and speed. A 200-mile day uses about 20-25 gallons of gas. At California prices ($4.50-5.50/gallon), that's $90-140 per day in fuel.

**Q: Can I cook inside the RV while driving?**
A: No. Propane appliances (stove, oven, fridge in gas mode) must be turned off while driving. The fridge will stay cold for a few hours on residual cooling, or can be switched to 12V battery mode.

**Q: Is the RV cleaned between rentals?**
A: Yes, thoroughly. Every vehicle is professionally cleaned, sanitized, and inspected between rentals. The $115 cleaning fee covers this service.

**Q: What happens if I damage something?**
A: Minor wear and tear is expected. Significant damage is assessed against the $1,500 security deposit. Anything beyond the deposit is covered by insurance up to coverage limits. We work with renters in good faith — accidents happen.

**Q: Is there a generator? When can I use it?**
A: Yes, every Crystal RV has an onboard generator. Use it for AC, microwave, or 110V outlets when not connected to shore power. Most campgrounds have generator hours (typically 7-9am and 5-8pm); respect those restrictions.

**Q: Can I drink the water from the tap?**
A: Yes. The fresh water tank is filled with potable water before delivery. If you refill from a campsite spigot marked "potable water," it's safe. Avoid non-potable spigots (irrigation, dump station rinse).

**Q: How long is the orientation?**
A: For first-time RVers: 45-60 minutes. For experienced renters: 20-30 minutes. We don't rush — knowing how your RV works prevents 90% of trip problems.

**Q: Can I rent for just one or two nights?**
A: No. Our minimum is 3 nights. This reflects the time investment in delivery, orientation, and cleaning.

**Q: Can I extend my rental mid-trip?**
A: If the vehicle is available, yes. Just call us. Extensions are billed at the same nightly rate.

**Q: What about insurance from my own auto policy?**
A: Most personal auto policies do not cover rented RVs. Our included insurance covers you fully. Some credit cards offer rental vehicle coverage, but it rarely applies to motorhomes — check with your card issuer.

## Why Choose Crystal RV vs Peer-to-Peer Platforms

Crystal RV is fundamentally different from Outdoorsy, RVshare, and other peer-to-peer platforms:

**1. We own and maintain the fleet ourselves.**
Peer-to-peer platforms connect you with individual RV owners. Quality varies wildly. Crystal RV's four vehicles are all maintained to the same high standard and inspected before every rental.

**2. Door-to-door delivery is standard.**
Most peer-to-peer rentals require you to pick up at the owner's location. We bring the RV to you, anywhere in the Bay Area. Complimentary for 5+ night trips in the primary zone.

**3. Fully stocked, no extra fees.**
Many peer-to-peer rentals charge separately for "kitchen kits," bedding, cleaning supplies, and outdoor gear. Every Crystal RV vehicle includes all of this in the base rate.

**4. Real orientation, not a 5-minute walkthrough.**
First-time renters get 45-60 minutes of in-person training on every system. Peer-to-peer hosts are often unwilling or unable to provide this.

**5. Direct phone support during your trip.**
Call (669) 245-5636 and reach Michael, Xeniya, or our team directly. No support ticket queues. No off-hours wait times.

**6. Better insurance.**
Our insurance package ($1M liability via Mobilitas, $300K collision via Lloyd's of London) is significantly more comprehensive than the standard peer-to-peer marketplace coverage.

**7. Higher-quality fleet.**
Our four vehicles are 2021-2025 model years. Peer-to-peer fleets include vehicles 10-15 years old.

## Service Areas (Detailed)

### San Jose
Service to all San Jose neighborhoods: Downtown, Almaden Valley, Willow Glen, Cambrian, Evergreen, Berryessa, Cupertino-adjacent. Closest to our Mountain View location (15-20 minute drive). Frequent corporate group bookings from Silicon Valley tech companies.

### San Francisco
Delivery to all SF neighborhoods including Mission, Marina, Sunset, Richmond, Bernal Heights, Potrero Hill, Castro, SoMa. Driving an RV in dense SF neighborhoods requires careful planning — we'll coordinate a delivery spot that works for your residence.

### Oakland and East Bay
Service to Oakland (all neighborhoods), Berkeley, Albany, El Cerrito, Fremont, Hayward, San Leandro, Castro Valley, Pleasanton, Livermore, Walnut Creek, Lafayette, Orinda. East Bay deliveries typically take 35-50 minutes from Mountain View.

### Marin County
Service to San Rafael, Mill Valley, Tiburon, Sausalito, Novato, Larkspur, Corte Madera, Fairfax, San Anselmo. Marin deliveries take 50-75 minutes. Popular destinations from Marin: Point Reyes, Sonoma, Russian River.

### Peninsula (Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Redwood City)
Service to Palo Alto (4 miles from our lot), Menlo Park, Atherton, Portola Valley, Woodside, Redwood City, San Carlos, Belmont, San Mateo, Foster City, Burlingame, Millbrae. Frequent destinations: Half Moon Bay, Pillar Point, Pescadero.

### Santa Clara and Sunnyvale
Service to Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Saratoga, Los Gatos, Los Altos, Los Altos Hills, Monte Sereno. Closest delivery zone to our Mountain View base. Often delivered same-day for last-minute bookings.

### Berkeley
Service to Berkeley, including campus area, North Berkeley, Elmwood, Claremont, Berkeley Hills, West Berkeley. Easy I-580/I-880 access from Mountain View, typically 45-60 minute delivery.

### Mountain View (Home Base)
Crystal RV is headquartered at 1001 La Avenida St, Mountain View, CA 94043, just off Hwy 101 between the Rengstorff Ave and Shoreline Blvd exits. Local guests enjoy free self-pickup (usually under 30 minutes door to door) or door delivery anywhere in town — near Castro Street, the Googleplex, NASA Ames, and Shoreline. This is our fastest service zone.

### Yosemite (Destination Trips)
Yosemite Valley is about 195 miles / 3.5–4 hours from our Mountain View base via I-580 to CA-120 (Big Oak Flat) or CA-140 through Mariposa. Class C motorhomes fit common length limits at Upper Pines, Hodgdon Meadow, Crane Flat, and Wawona inside the park, plus gateway resorts like Yosemite Pines and Indian Flat. Park entry and campground reservation rules vary by season — check the National Park Service and Recreation.gov for current requirements. Bear-safe food storage required in the park.

### Airport Pickup (SFO and SJC)
Crystal RV serves fly-and-drive travelers. SFO is about 25 miles / 30–40 minutes north of our base via Hwy 101; San Jose Mineta (SJC) is about 12 miles / 15–20 minutes south. Guests take a short rideshare to our Mountain View base for free self-pickup, or we coordinate delivery timed to the inbound flight. Airport delivery is a $100/trip add-on. RVs arrive fully stocked so out-of-town guests skip the supply run.

## Specialty Use Cases

### Corporate and Group Rentals
Crystal RV serves corporate groups for team off-sites, retreats, and adventures. Multiple vehicle bookings available. Common destinations: Half Moon Bay, Big Sur, Lake Tahoe, Yosemite. Coordination includes campground reservations, route planning, and group orientation. Custom invoicing and 30-day net terms available for business accounts.

### Emergency Housing
Crystal RV provides emergency temporary RV housing for Bay Area families displaced by wildfire, flooding, or other emergencies. We can deliver within 24 hours during emergencies. Vehicles are fully stocked and ready for immediate occupancy. Insurance company billing accepted; FEMA reimbursement guidance available. Have helped families displaced by the 2020 CZU Complex, 2024 atmospheric river flooding, and other emergencies.

### Pet-Friendly Rentals
The 2021 Thor Daybreak 22GOC is our pet-friendly vehicle. Welcomes dogs, cats, and birds. $50 pet cleaning fee per trip. Pets must be potty trained and supervised. Maximum 2 pets. Pet-friendly trip recommendations: Samuel P. Taylor (dog-friendly trails), Point Reyes (off-leash beaches), Half Moon Bay (beach walking).

### Weekend Rentals
3-night minimum (Friday-Monday is the most common weekend booking). Frequently combined with Pillar Point, Half Moon Bay, or Marin destinations for short-and-sweet escapes. Same-week availability is often possible for weekend trips.

### Last-Minute Rentals
Crystal RV can frequently accommodate last-minute bookings with 24-48 hours notice. Last-minute availability is best for shoulder season (March-May, September-November) and midweek dates. Call (669) 245-5636 to check.

### Family RV Rentals
All vehicles sleep 5-6 and are well-suited to families with young children. The Coachmen Leprechaun is the most popular family choice — Murphy bed converts to a play area during the day. Kid-friendly destinations: Petaluma KOA, Half Moon Bay, Yosemite Valley.

### Event Rentals
Crystal RV is minutes from Shoreline Amphitheatre and about 10 minutes from Levi's Stadium (host of Super Bowl LX and FIFA World Cup matches in 2026). Groups rent RVs as a basecamp for concerts, 49ers games, Laguna Seca race weekends, Napa festivals and graduations. Most venue lots do not allow overnight stays, so guests typically stay at a nearby RV park. Details: https://crystalrv.com/rv-rental-events.html

### Destination Notes (verified November 2026)
- Big Sur: Caltrans reopened Highway 1 at Regent's Slide on January 14, 2026; storms can still cause temporary closures.
- Yosemite: no timed-entry reservation in 2026; campground reservations still required.
- Sequoia: NPS advises against vehicles over 22 ft between Potwisha and Giant Forest (Hwy 198 side). Crystal RV's 24–25 ft RVs should enter via Hwy 180 / Big Stump. Dorst Creek Campground is closed for 2026.
- Death Valley: Furnace Creek Campground reservations Oct 15–Apr 15; only 18 full-hookup sites.
